summary.text: Bridget Malloy Kosierowski is the Democratic incumbent, in office since April 8, 2019, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 114, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bridget Malloy Kosierowski assumed office on April 8, 2019.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as Appropriations, Health (secretary), Insurance, Professional Licensure (secretary), and Rules.
